```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": d["max_concurrency"],
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "input_throughput": d["input_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "total_token_throughput": d["total_token_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "p90_ttft_ms": d["p90_ttft_ms"],
                "p99_ttft_ms": d["p99_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "p90_tpot_ms": d["p90_tpot_ms"],
                "p99_tpot_ms": d["p99_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_itl_ms": d["mean_itl_ms"],
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
                "p90_e2el_ms": d["p90_e2el_ms"],
                "p99_e2el_ms": d["p99_e2el_ms"],
                "max_concurrent_requests": d.get("max_concurrent_requests"),
                "date": d.get("date"),
                "model_id": d.get("model_id"),
            }
        )
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)
    tok1 = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    df["ideal_output_tok_s"] = tok1 * df["concurrency"]
    df["scaling_efficiency"] = df["output_throughput"] / df["ideal_output_tok_s"]
    return df


df_tp16 = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000", "TP16")
df_pp2 = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000", "TP8×PP2")
base_tp16 = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_pp2 = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]

tp16_seed = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000" / "seed.txt"
pp2_seed = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000" / "seed.txt"
TP16_SEED = tp16_seed.read_text().strip() if tp16_seed.exists() else "n/a"
PP2_SEED = pp2_seed.read_text().strip() if pp2_seed.exists() else "n/a"

both = pd.concat([df_tp16, df_pp2], ignore_index=True)
shared = sorted(set(df_tp16["concurrency"]) & set(df_pp2["concurrency"]))
cmp_rows = []
for c in shared:
    t = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    p = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    cmp_rows.append(
        {
            "concurrency": c,
            "tp16_tok_s": t["output_throughput"],
            "pp2_tok_s": p["output_throughput"],
            "tok_ratio": p["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "tp16_req_s": t["request_throughput"],
            "pp2_req_s": p["request_throughput"],
            "tp16_tpot": t["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "pp2_tpot": p["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "tp16_ttft": t["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "pp2_ttft": p["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "tp16_e2el_s": t["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "pp2_e2el_s": p["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "tp16_eff": t["scaling_efficiency"],
            "pp2_eff": p["scaling_efficiency"],
        }
    )
cmp = pd.DataFrame(cmp_rows)
tok_ratio_c1 = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "tok_ratio"].iloc[0]
peak_tp16 = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_pp2 = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
```

# Overview

Two `vllm bench serve` concurrency sweeps on **fozzie** (2×8 H200), same real MXFP4 checkpoint (`/models/Kimi-K3`), same prompt shape (**1000 in / 1000 out**, `--ignore-eos`, `--request-rate inf`). Row set matches the [NVIDIA Dynamo Kimi-K3 “Compare All Targets”](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/dev/recipes/kimi-k3#compare-all-targets) table, plus harness knobs for this sweep:

| | **TP16** | **TP8×PP2** |
|--|----------|-------------|
| **GPUs** | 16× H200 (2 nodes × 8) | 16× H200 (2 nodes × 8) |
| **Workers** | 1 (aggregated; rank-0 API + headless rank-1) | 1 (aggregated; rank-0 API + headless rank-1) |
| **Parallelism** | TP16 | TP8 × PP2 (one PP stage / node) |
| **KV transfer** | — (no P/D disagg) | — (no P/D disagg; PP activations over NCCL IB) |
| **Attention** | FLASHMLA | FLASHMLA |
| **Precision** | MXFP4 checkpoint (marlin MoE); default KV dtype | MXFP4 checkpoint (marlin MoE); default KV dtype |
| **Max context** | 8192 (`--max-model-len`) | 8192 (`--max-model-len`) |
| `--max-num-seqs` | 128 | 256 |
| `--gpu-memory-utilization` | 0.97 | 0.90 |
| MoE backend | marlin | marlin |
| Interconnect | NCCL / RoCE IB (cross-node TP) | NCCL / RoCE IB (`NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_5`, `NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3`) |
| Sweep seed | `{python} TP16_SEED` | `{python} PP2_SEED` |
| Data | [`conc-sweep-real-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-real-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000) |

Bring-up: [`scripts/deploy-recipe.sh`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/blob/main/scripts/deploy-recipe.sh) vs [`scripts/deploy-recipe-pp.sh`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/blob/main/scripts/deploy-recipe-pp.sh). Cross-node PP P2P required the IPv4-mapped RoCE GID above (default IPv6 link-local GIDs failed with `IBV_WC_RETRY_EXC_ERR`).

```{python}
#| label: method-meta
print(
    f"TP16 tiers: {list(df_tp16['concurrency'])}  |  C=1 = {base_tp16['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s\n"
    f"PP2  tiers: {list(df_pp2['concurrency'])}  |  C=1 = {base_pp2['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s"
)
```

# Head-to-head

```{python}
#| label: tbl-compare
#| tbl-cap: "Shared concurrency tiers — throughput and latency."

show = cmp.copy()
show["tp16_tok_s"] = show["tp16_tok_s"].round(1)
show["pp2_tok_s"] = show["pp2_tok_s"].round(1)
show["tok_ratio"] = show["tok_ratio"].round(3)
show["tp16_tpot"] = show["tp16_tpot"].round(2)
show["pp2_tpot"] = show["pp2_tpot"].round(2)
show["tp16_ttft"] = show["tp16_ttft"].round(1)
show["pp2_ttft"] = show["pp2_ttft"].round(1)
show["tp16_e2el_s"] = show["tp16_e2el_s"].round(1)
show["pp2_e2el_s"] = show["pp2_e2el_s"].round(1)
show["tp16_eff"] = (show["tp16_eff"] * 100).round(1)
show["pp2_eff"] = (show["pp2_eff"] * 100).round(1)
show[
    [
        "concurrency",
        "tp16_tok_s",
        "pp2_tok_s",
        "tok_ratio",
        "tp16_tpot",
        "pp2_tpot",
        "tp16_ttft",
        "pp2_ttft",
        "tp16_e2el_s",
        "pp2_e2el_s",
        "tp16_eff",
        "pp2_eff",
    ]
].rename(
    columns={
        "concurrency": "C",
        "tp16_tok_s": "TP16 tok/s",
        "pp2_tok_s": "PP2 tok/s",
        "tok_ratio": "PP2/TP16",
        "tp16_tpot": "TP16 TPOT",
        "pp2_tpot": "PP2 TPOT",
        "tp16_ttft": "TP16 TTFT",
        "pp2_ttft": "PP2 TTFT",
        "tp16_e2el_s": "TP16 E2EL s",
        "pp2_e2el_s": "PP2 E2EL s",
        "tp16_eff": "TP16 scale%",
        "pp2_eff": "PP2 scale%",
    }
)
```

```{python}
#| label: findings-compare
#| output: asis
hi = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] >= 32, "tok_ratio"]
print(f"""
- **@C=1:** PP2/TP16 = **{tok_ratio_c1:.3f}** ({base_pp2['output_throughput']:.0f} vs {base_tp16['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s). PP2 TPOT {base_pp2['mean_tpot_ms']:.1f} ms vs TP16 {base_tp16['mean_tpot_ms']:.1f} ms.
- **Peak tok/s:** PP2 **{peak_pp2['output_throughput']:.0f}** @C={int(peak_pp2['concurrency'])}; TP16 **{peak_tp16['output_throughput']:.0f}** @C={int(peak_tp16['concurrency'])} (**{peak_pp2['output_throughput']/peak_tp16['output_throughput']:.2f}×**).
- **@C≥32:** PP2/TP16 tok/s ratio ~**{hi.min():.2f}–{hi.max():.2f}**. PP2 keeps scaling past the TP16 plateau (TP16 `--max-num-seqs 128`; PP2 256).
""")
```

## Throughput

```{python}
#| label: fig-tok
#| fig-cap: "Output token throughput vs concurrency."

fig = px.line(
    both,
    x="concurrency",
    y="output_throughput",
    color="run",
    markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "output_throughput": "out tok/s", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-req
#| fig-cap: "Request throughput vs concurrency."

fig = px.line(
    both,
    x="concurrency",
    y="request_throughput",
    color="run",
    markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "request_throughput": "req/s", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Throughput ratio PP2 ÷ TP16 (parity = 1.0)."

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=cmp["concurrency"],
        y=cmp["tok_ratio"],
        mode="lines+markers",
        name="tok/s PP2÷TP16",
        hovertemplate="C=%{x}<br>ratio=%{y:.3f}<extra></extra>",
    )
)
fig.add_hline(y=1.0, line_dash="dash", annotation_text="parity", annotation_position="top right")
fig.update_xaxes(title_text="max concurrency", type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="PP2 / TP16 tok/s")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-efficiency
#| fig-cap: "Scaling efficiency vs C · tok/s@1."

fig = px.line(
    both,
    x="concurrency",
    y="scaling_efficiency",
    color="run",
    markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "scaling_efficiency": "efficiency vs C·tok₁", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_yaxes(tickformat=".0%", range=[0, 1.15])
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

## Latency

```{python}
#| label: fig-latency
#| fig-cap: "Mean TPOT, TTFT, and E2EL."

fig = make_subplots(
    rows=1,
    cols=3,
    subplot_titles=("TPOT (ms)", "TTFT (ms)", "E2EL (s)"),
)
for run, dfx, color in [("TP16", df_tp16, "#1f77b4"), ("TP8×PP2", df_pp2, "#ff7f0e")]:
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_tpot_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=f"{run}",
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=True,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_ttft_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=f"{run}",
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=2,
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=f"{run}",
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=3,
    )
for col in (1, 2, 3):
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=col)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=2)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=3)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.08), margin=dict(t=50))
fig.show()
```

## TP16

```{python}
#| label: tbl-tp16
#| tbl-cap: "TP16 real weights — per-concurrency summary."

show = df_tp16[
    [
        "concurrency",
        "num_prompts",
        "duration_s",
        "request_throughput",
        "output_throughput",
        "mean_ttft_ms",
        "mean_tpot_ms",
        "mean_e2el_ms",
        "scaling_efficiency",
    ]
].copy()
show["duration_s"] = show["duration_s"].round(1)
show["request_throughput"] = show["request_throughput"].round(3)
show["output_throughput"] = show["output_throughput"].round(1)
show["mean_ttft_ms"] = show["mean_ttft_ms"].round(1)
show["mean_tpot_ms"] = show["mean_tpot_ms"].round(2)
show["mean_e2el_ms"] = (show["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000).round(1)
show["scaling_efficiency"] = (show["scaling_efficiency"] * 100).round(1)
show.rename(
    columns={
        "concurrency": "C",
        "num_prompts": "prompts",
        "duration_s": "dur (s)",
        "request_throughput": "req/s",
        "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
        "mean_ttft_ms": "TTFT ms",
        "mean_tpot_ms": "TPOT ms",
        "mean_e2el_ms": "E2EL s",
        "scaling_efficiency": "scale %",
    }
)
```
